verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm a keyless, agent-readable llms.txt on the product site. It covers install channels, editor connectors, pricing and data handling. A second llms.txt on docs.byteask.ai indexes every CLI documentation page, so an agent can be pointed at either file. Missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs (the /docs/overview.md probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: keyless GET of https://byteask.ai/llms.txt returned the product-site llms.txt index (text/plain)
the docs subdomain serves its own llms.txt index
